The [[armor]] was made from [[beskar]]. It consisted of a [[helmet]], a cuirass, [[Mandalorian vambrace|vambraces]] with [[retractable wrist blades]], and a [[Z-6 jetpack]]. In addition, the armor featured an array of weapons and gadgets, such as a [[Czerka Arms]] [[ZX miniature flame projector]], a [[BlasTech Industries]] [[Dur-24 wrist laser]], and a [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms]] [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher]]. In addition, the armor contained a [[chain code]] which identified the [[Fetts]] as its owners. The armor was originally owned by [[Jango Fett]], a [[foundling]] whose [[Clone template|genetic template]] served as the [[DNA|foundation]] for Boba and the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. For a [[time]], the armor was in the possession in turn of [[Cobb Vanth]] and the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]]. Jango was [[Death|killed]] in [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] by [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] while wearing the armor, which ultimately came into the possession of Boba. The armor was repainted in distinctive [[color]]s and used by Boba during his career as a [[bounty]] hunter. Following the [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] of [[Han Solo]], a group of [[Jawa]]s [[Scavenger|scavenged]] the armor from Boba who was injured after falling into a [[sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. Following the [[Galactic Empire]]'s defeat at the [[Battle of Endor]], Boba's armor was sold by Jawas to Cobb Vanth. Vanth used the armor to [[Law enforcement agency|protect]] the inhabitants of [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]], a settlement on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], during the [[New Republic Era]]. He surrendered the armor to Din Djarin in return for the Mandalorian's assistance in [[Mission to Tatooine (Din Djarin)|destroying]] a [[Leviathan krayt dragon|krayt dragon]]. The armor was subsequently reclaimed by Boba whom Djarin [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|encountered]] on [[Tython]]. After [[Second rescue of Grogu|working]] with the Mandalorian, Boba returned to Tatooine with his armor and became the new [[crime lord]] of a [[Fett gotra|criminal empire]]. ==Description== {{Quote|Mandalorian battle armor. Whole box. Complete set, by the looks of it. Been through hell and back.|[[Adwin Charu]]|}} [[File:JangoFett-SWBC7.png|thumb|left|250px|Jango Fett wore the armor before it passed to his son, Boba.]] The customized [[Mandalorian armor]]{{Databank|boba-fett|Boba Fett}} that was worn in turn by [[Jango Fett]] and [[Boba Fett]] featured an arsenal of deadly weaponry. The [[Mandalorian vambrace|vambraces]] included [[retractable wrist blades]], a snare, a [[Czerka Arms]] [[ZX miniature flame projector]], a [[BlasTech Industries]] [[Dur-24 wrist laser]], a display that was connected to [[Imperial Enforcement DataCore]] to help locate [[Bounty|bounties]],''[[Gadgets and Gear]]'' and a [[Kelvarek Consolidated Arms|Kelvarek Industries]] [[MM7 rocket launcher]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Blasters and Ranged Weapons}} which was later replaced with a [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher]]. The vambraces were painted [[Color|red]] for the majority of their usage,{{Film|VI}} despite being painted green for a time before returning to the prior hue. Additionally, the armor contained a [[chain code]] within the left vambrace. The encoded file held information regarding the armor's owners, from Jango to Boba Fett. [[File:BobaFett-ep6.png|thumb|right|300px|The Fett armor as it was during Boba's bounty hunting career]] The armor also included a [[Z-6 jetpack]] that allowed the armor's wearer to engage in aerial travel and combat over short distances. The [[jetpack]] contained an explosive [[missile]] that could be launched from it.{{Databank|jango-fett|Jango Fett}} In addition to the Z-6 model, Jango owned a [[JT-12 jetpack]]. [[Kneepad rocket dart launcher]]s were integrated in the right kneepad of the armor as well. The [[armor]] was forged from [[beskar]]. It was originally [[Color|silver]] and blue while in Jango's possession. Its sleek design was eventually altered to a green and brownish red appearance after Boba inherited it. By the [[time]] of the [[Imperial Era]], the armor featured a [[Mythosaur]] [[Bone|skull]] sigil as well as [[braid]]s made from [[Wookiee]]s that Boba had defeated in combat.[[War of the Bounty Hunters 3|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 3]] [[File:BobaFettThrone-SWI206.png|thumb|left|300px|Boba Fett restored his armor after regaining it and used it as leader of his own criminal family.]] Despite its battle worn condition by the time of the [[New Republic Era]], the armor was still an effective tool that allowed the individual who wore it to shrug off [[blaster]] bolts and defeat multiple opponents in a firefight. Boba replaced his father's destroyed Z-6 jetpack with a nearly identical model, as well as an additional pack distinguished by its green color scheme that he used interchangeably. After recovering his armor{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 15: The Believer}} in [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|15}} Boba promptly restored it, giving it a new paintjob. ==History== ===Armor of Jango Fett=== {{Quote|I recently encountered a man who wore Mandalorian armor. Jango Fett.''"
"''Jango Fett was a common bounty hunter. How he acquired that armor is beyond me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Almec|{{TCW|The Mandalore Plot}}}} Boba Fett's armor was inherited from his [[clone template]]—or "father"—Jango Fett, who received it from the [[Mandalorian]]s after he became a [[foundling]]. Fett originally bore his armor as a [[Mandalorian warrior]]''[[Star Wars: Character Encyclopedia, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' during the [[Mandalorian Civil Wars]], the conflict during which he was given the armor in the first place.{{BustCollectionCite|20|Character}} {{C|English release}} During his storied career as a [[bounty hunter]], Jango used his armor to great effect, collecting [[Bounty|bounties]] for various clients. When Fett was hired to be a [[Cloning|clone]] template, he was wearing the armor.[[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]] He continued to wear the armor during the last [[Standard day|days]] of his life, when he was employed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]]. Regardless, [[Prime Minister]] [[Almec]] of [[Mandalore]] did not consider Jango a member of his people, but rather a simple bounty hunter who somehow acquired Mandalorian armor. [[File:JangoFett1-virginvariant-Chew.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The armor was used to great effect by Jango Fett as a bounty hunter.]] With the armor, Jango was able to [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)|fight]] the [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] while attempting to leave the [[planet]] [[Kamino]]. His combat gear allowed him to compete against the [[Jedi]]'s [[lightsaber combat]] skills and [[Force-sensitive]] [[Force power|abilities]]. After his Z-6 jetpack was destroyed, Jango fled from [[Tipoca City]] along with Boba, his cloned son, before Kenobi could stop them. Jango later replaced his lost Z-6 with a [[JT-12 jetpack]]. The [[Fetts]] retreated to [[Geonosis]] where Jango engaged another member of the [[Jedi Order]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]], whom he was no match against. As Windu advanced toward Jango, deflecting the [[mercenary]]'s blaster bolts with his [[lightsaber]], Jango tried to escape but his JT-12 jetpack malfunctioned. As a result, Jango was decapitated by a single strike across his neck by [[Mace Windu's lightsaber|Windu's blade]]. Jango's death was witnessed by Boba, who recovered his father's helmet after the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]—[[clone trooper]]s bred from Jango's template—arrived to [[First Battle of Geonosis|fight]] the [[Separatist Droid Army]]. ===Boba Fett's inheritance=== {{Quote|You are a disgrace to your armor.''"
"''This armor belonged to my father.''"
"''Don't you mean your donor?|Bo-Katan Kryze and Boba Fett|{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}}} [[File:Wing_Guards_Fett.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Jango's armor was inherited by his cloned son, Boba Fett, who became a deadly bounty hunter.]] With Jango's [[death]], his armor passed to Boba. During the [[Clone Wars]], Boba [[Mission to Vanqor|tried to kill]] Windu with a [[bomb]] that he planted inside his [[Parent|father's]] [[helmet]]. Although the explosive was triggered by Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker]], Windu not only survived but also saved Skywalker in the process. While trapped under the wreckage of the ''[[Endurance]]'', Windu inspected the damaged helmet of the hunter that he defeated on Geonosis, having realized that Boba was involved in the [[Sabotage of the Endurance|plot]] against him.{{TCW|R2 Come Home}} The helmet used as a trap to lure Windu was destroyed by a [[baradium]] charge explosion. Fragments of the helmet were later recovered by the Republic, and metallurgical analysis confirmed its unparalleled besker purity.''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'' Boba ultimately followed in Jango's footsteps, donning the Mandalorian armor as a bounty hunter during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The armor became a defining characteristic of Fett and his reputation.[[War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters Alpha'' 1]] He was one of several hunters hired by the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth]] Vader to track a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[starship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. By then, Fett had a reputation for disintegrating his prey, which Vader, who wanted the Falcon's crew taken alive, warned him against. Eager to gain [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]'s [[bounty]] on the Rebel-aligned [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], with whom Boba had prior dealings,{{StoryCite|story=Added Muscle|book=From a Certain Point of View}}{{IDWAdventuresCite-2020|issue=9|story=Tales of Villainy: Trade Relations (Star Wars Adventures 9)}} Fett helped in the [[Escape from Cloud City|early stages]] of the Imperial occupation of Cloud City and left with Solo's body [[Carbon-freezing|frozen]] in [[carbonite]]. [[File:BobaFettBlackArmor-WBHADC.png|thumb|right|200px|Boba Fett painted his armor black and entered an arena under his father's name to avoid the eyes of the Kanji Criminal Enterprise.]] However, Fett's journey to [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on [[Tatooine]] to claim the bounty on Solo was distracted by the return of his former ally [[Nakano Lash]],[[Bounty Hunters 1|''Bounty Hunters'' 1]] whom Fett held a grudge against[[Bounty Hunters 5|''Bounty Hunters'' 5]] and elected to hunt down in revenge. Fett's diversion resulted in Solo's carbonite form beginning to destabilize, forcing him to again divert his journey to head to the [[moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa]], where he hired the services of [[Doctor]] [[Ragon]] in stabilizing the carbonite. Unable to pay Ragon for his work, Fett agreed to enter the [[Garkata Fighting Arena]] and kill the champion [[Wyrmen Lictor]], thereby avenging a fighter Ragon had sponsored previously. As the [[The Arena|arena]] was owned by the [[Kanji Criminal Enterprise]], Fett did not want to directly anger the syndicate and thus used some of Ragon's [[nano-spray paint]] to disguise his armor, painting it black and entering the arena under his father's name. While "Beskar Brawler Jango" fought through the arena and killed Lictor, agents of the re-emerging [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate killed Ragon and stole Solo's carbonite form as part of [[Lady]] [[Qi'ra]]'s [[Auction for Han Solo|plans]].[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]] Returning his armor to its normal color, Fett used his armor in the ensuing [[War of the Bounty Hunters]] to reclaim Solo and deliver him to Jabba.[[War of the Bounty Hunters 5|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 5]] Boba later fought against the [[Padawan|Jedi apprentice]] [[Luke Skywalker]] during the [[Rescue of Han Solo|mission to rescue]] Solo on Tatooine. After failing to kill or subdue the Jedi with his weapons, Boba tried to shoot Skywalker while he was distracted.{{Film|VI}} During the fight, Fett's jetpack sustained a gash in the back. Before Fett could land a shot on Skywalker, a blind Solo accidentally hit Boba's jetpack, causing the bounty hunter to careen into the side of [[Khetanna|Jabba's sail barge]] before tumbling into the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] where a [[sarlacc]] swallowed him. [[File:JawasStripShow-Displate.png|thumb|left|300px|Boba Fett's armor was stolen by Jawas, who removed it from the unconscious bounty hunter following his escape from the sarlacc.]] Fett survived his fall into the sarlacc, and managed to escape by activating his [[flamethrower]] to burn through the sarlacc's hide, and dug himself out of the pit. Exhausted and suffering wounds from the encounter with the beast, Fett collapsed near the wreckage of the ''Khetanna''. Some time later, he was found by a group of [[Jawa]]s that had yellow eyes, who separated him from his armor, which had become acid-scarred from the sarlacc. When Fett attempted to resist their attempts at theft, he was knocked out by the Jawas and left for dead. Sometime after the [[Battle of Endor|destruction]] of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]], the Jawas traded the armor to [[Cobb Vanth]] for a [[camtono]] of [[silicax oxalate]] crystals. ===Cobb Vanth, Lawman on Tatooine=== [[File:CobbVanth-TMH.png|thumb|right|250px|Cobb Vanth purchased Fett's armor from the Jawa scavengers who took it from him.]] {{Quote|As much as I've grown fond of the armor, I'm even more fond of this town. The Mandalorian is willing to help us slay the leviathan in exchange for returning the armor to its ancestral owners.|Cobb Vanth|}} Although he used it to protect the residents of [[Freetown|Mos Pelgo]] as their [[marshal]], the Mandalorian [[bounty]] hunter [[Din Djarin]] demanded that he surrender the suit to him when they met in 9 ABY, as Djarin believed that Mandalorian armor belongs to the Mandalorians. Vanth agreed in exchange for Djarin's help in [[Death|slaying]] a [[Leviathan krayt dragon|krayt dragon]]. They managed to kill the dragon, and Vanth gave the armor to Djarin. ===Return to Boba Fett=== {{Quote|I don't want ''your'' armor. I want ''my'' armor that you got from Cobb Vanth back on Tatooine. It belongs to ''me''.|Boba Fett, to Din Djarin|}} [[File:CobbandDjarinGoodbye.png|thumb|left|250px|Boba Fett's armor passed from Vanth to the Mandalorian Din Djarin.]] Boba Fett attempted to recover his armor following his time with the Tusken Raiders. Joined by [[Fennec Shand]], he returned to the sarlacc pit after retrieving his personal [[starship]], ''[[Slave I]]'', unaware that the armor had been taken by Jawas. Shand assumed that the armor had disintegrated within the sarlacc, but Fett knew that its beskar would remain intact. After Fett searched the creature's remains, Shand advised him to cease his efforts to recover it, asserting that the armor served its purpose by allowing him to survive within the sarlacc. Fett located his armor by the time Din Djarin acquired it from Cobb Vanth. Fett and Shand followed Djarin to the planet [[Tython]], where Fett attempted to reclaim his armor from the Mandalorian. Djarin refused to surrender the armor after Fett denied having any allegiance or loyalty to the Mandalorians, despite his father Jango's past affiliation with them. Their dispute was interrupted by the arrival of [[stormtrooper]]s loyal to [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. During the [[Battle of Tython (9 ABY)|skirmish]], Fett took advantage of the situation to reclaim the armor from Djarin's ship, the [[Razor Crest]]. Donning the armor, Fett returned to the battle and brought it to a swift end. After Fett presented the armor's chain code, providing proof of ownership and revealing that his father was a Mandalorian foundling, Djarin acknowledged Boba's claim on the armor. [[File:BobaFett-Timelines.png|thumb|right|200px|Boba Fett in his repainted armor, with his helmet removed]] Before a [[Mission to Morak|mission]] to [[Morak]], Fett repainted his armor, restoring its vivid colors. Fett also produced the missing left kneepad, which was absent during the Jawas' and Vanth's ownership of the armor. Despite wearing his newly restored gear, Fett was unable to help Djarin infiltrate an [[Morak Imperial refinery|Imperial refinery]] during the Morak mission, citing that he could need to remove his helmet and that the Imperials would recognize his face. Fett thus served as their get-away-pilot aboard the ''Slave I''. Fett encountered the Mandalorians [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Koska Reeves]] when Djarin attempted to recruit them for his [[Second rescue of Grogu|plan to rescue]] the foundling [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. Kryze denounced Fett, stating that he was not a Mandalorian in spite of the armor that he wore and the fact Jango was a Mandalorian, although Fett countered that he never claimed to be Mandalorian himself even despite his heritage. Recognizing the bounty hunter as a clone by the voice he shared with the clone [[trooper]]s who fought in the Clone Wars, Kryze told Fett that he disgraced his armor. She also referred to the armor's original owner as Fett's donor rather than his father, causing Fett to threaten Kryze. A physical altercation ensued between Fett and Reeves, both of whom utilized their armor's weaponry against each other until Kryze stepped in to end the fight. The armor remained in Boba Fett's possession following the rescue of Grogu from Moff [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]]. ===Lord Boba Fett=== {{Quote|Would you like your helmet serviced and cleaned while you wait for Madam Garsa?|A Twi'lek attendant, to Boba Fett and Fennec Shand|}} [[File:BoBFTextlessHorizontalPoster-Displate.png|thumb|left|300px|Donning his restored armor and armed with his blaster carbine, Boba Fett assumed his place as Daimyo of Mos Espa.]] With his debt to the Mandalorian paid, Fett journeyed to Tatooine with Shand. In [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's former Palace]], Fett killed and replaced [[Bib Fortuna]] as a [[crime lord]]. The newly styled crime [[lord]] established his residence in the Palace, where he kept a [[Bacta tank|bacta pod]] along with several [[droid]]s to assist him with putting on his armor. By then, Boba experienced recurring [[dream]]s of his past, including the time when he recovered his father's helmet after Jango's death on Geonosis. Fett wore the armor for official functions, such granting audiences to guests and receiving their gifts as the new [[Daimyo]]. Rather than following Jabba's example of ruling through fear, Fett sought to build his [[Fett gotra|gotra]] by gaining the respect of his vassals. Though he shunned the usual trappings of a crime lord, such as riding in a litter like a [[noble]]man, Fett made an effort to acclimate to the local customs of Tatooine. As such, he permitted one of the [[Twi'lek]] attendants at the [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary]]—[[Garsa Fwip]]'s [[cantina]] in [[Mos Espa]]—to clean his helmet. Fett's reign was challenged by the arriving [[Pyke Syndicate]], culminating in a [[War against the Pykes|gang war on Tatooine]]. Fett used his armor in the [[Battle of Mos Espa]], which affirmed his place as the Daimyo of Tatooine and defeated the Pyke Syndicate's forces on world.{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}} ==Behind the scenes== A clip of unfinished animation from a canceled episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' was shown during the Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates panel at [[Celebration Orlando]] in [[2017]]. The segment featured Boba Fett donning his iconic armor for the first time in the show during a duel with fellow bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]]. The episode would have also served to explain the origins of the large dent on Fett's helmet, that being a mark from Bane's blast shot.{{SW|text=SWCO 2017: 11 Things We Learned from Dave Filoni and Pablo Hidalgo's "Animated Origins and Unexpected Fates" Panel|url=news/swco-2017-11-things-we-learned-from-dave-filoni-and-pablo-hidalgos-animated-origins-and-unexpected-fates-panel}} In the [[Helmets (department)|Helmets]] section of the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 2|second issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' titled "Boba Fett–Notorious Bounty Hunter," it was noted that Fett's helmet was made of [[Duraplast]].{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Helmets}} The [[2018]] [[canon]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' states that Fett's armor was made of [[durasteel]].''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' However, the [[Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm|fourth episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'' establishes that the armor is made of [[beskar]].
